tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Check whether a set of PC parts will physically and electrically work together - socket, chipset, RAM type, GPU clearance, cooler height, PSU headroom and connectors. Give part names as free text; they are matched against the live catalogue.

tools.name: estimate_fps
tools.description: Estimate frame rates for a CPU + GPU pairing across popular games at a chosen resolution and quality preset, including 1% lows and which component is the bottleneck.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "build_pc" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
